test.create_query: CREATE TABLE qbit_one_bit (id UInt32, vec QBit(BFloat16, 1024)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
INSERT INTO qbit_one_bit SELECT number, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(randCanonical(i + number) - 0.5), range(1024)) FROM numbers_mt(100000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8, max_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT sum({func}(vec, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(sin(i)), range(1024)), 1)) FROM qbit_one_bit SETTINGS qbit_one_bit_symmetric_distance = {symmetric}
SELECT id FROM qbit_one_bit ORDER BY {func}(vec, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(sin(i)), range(1024)), 1) LIMIT 10 SETTINGS qbit_one_bit_symmetric_distance = {symmetric}
